summary: L.A. Care grievance acknowledgment letter dated April 1, 2026, annotated by Nicolas Hernandez. The annotations highlight that L.A. Care explicitly acknowledged grievances regarding Call The Car (CTC) transportation and CVS pharmacy access, which were subsequently suppressed and omitted from the May 1 resolution letter. It also points out the automated 'Mr./Ms.' salutation and the incorrect physical address on the letter.

LA. Care

HEALTH PLANs

For All of L.A.

April 01, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ Member Name: NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
Member ID: [REDACTED]
Reference Number: [REDACTED]47
Line of Business: MCLA
Date of Service: March 27, 2026
Regarding: Quality of Service
Case Number: [REDACTED]47

Dear Mr./Ms. NICOLAS HERNANDEZ,

Thank you for bringing your concern(s) about Call The Car (CTC) transportation and CVS Pharmacy access issues and conduct concerns to our attention on March 27, 2026. L.A. Care Health Plan has your grievance into our complaint process for review. A written response will be provided within 30 days of the receipt of your concern.

California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) Office of the Ombudsman
You may also call the Ombudsman Office of the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) for help. The Ombudsman Office helps Medi-Cal beneficiaries to fully use their rights and responsibilities as a member of a managed care plan. To find out more, call toll-free 1-888-452-8609 Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm PST; excluding holidays.

Department of Managed Health Care
The California Department of Managed Health Care is responsible for regulating health care service plans. If you have a grievance against your health plan, you should first telephone your health plan at 1-888-839-9909 and use your health plan’s grievance process before contacting the department. Utilizing this grievance procedure does not prohibit any potential legal rights or remedies that may be available to you. If you need help with a grievance involving an emergency, a grievance that has not been satisfactorily resolved by your health plan, or a grievance that has remained unresolved for more than 30 days, you may call the department for assistance. You may also be eligible for an Independent Medical Review (IMR). If you are eligible for IMR, the IMR process will provide an impartial review of medical decisions made by a health plan related to the medical necessity of a proposed service or treatment, coverage

1055 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017 | lacare.org
A public entity serving Los Angeles County

1633

   Annotation: "Automation at its finest..."

3. [RED CORRECTION marking out "10th floor" in the footer address "1055 W. 7th Street, 10th floor"]
   Annotation: The user crossed out "10th floor" to highlight L.A. Care's persistent use of a non-existent physical location in their directory files.
